{{Top|leg}}
'''Nalvar''' was a region in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]]. It was known because of its harshness, even if every region of Svivren was harsh. The humid mines of Nalvar were also famous,<ref name="G0">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> as well as the [[Nalvar grass]] of thick leaves.<ref name="WBC">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
